platform: Cloud SaaS and web-based school ERP/LMS with native Android and iOS apps; no verified on-premise edition.

distinctive_features.feature: VED AI combines writing support, translation, content assistance, and extraction from PDFs, images, and spreadsheets.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Staff can use several school-oriented AI tasks within one product suite.

distinctive_features.feature: Examcell generates curriculum-aligned question papers with AI and manual question-bank selection, configurable sections, difficulty balancing, and individualized papers.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Exam teams can combine automated drafting with control over assessment structure.

distinctive_features.feature: NEP Holistic Progress Card supports foundational, preparatory, middle, and secondary stages.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Schools can produce stage-specific reporting beyond conventional marksheets.

distinctive_features.feature: Higher-education OBE includes CO–PO/PSO mapping, attainment calculations, and NBA/NAAC reports.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Colleges can support outcome-based assessment and accreditation workflows.

distinctive_features.feature: Connect combines SMS, WhatsApp, voice, email, push notifications, diary, and school calendar.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Schools can reach families through multiple communication channels.

distinctive_features.feature: Franchise Management provides centralized oversight for education chains.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Multi-branch operators can coordinate operations across campuses.

distinctive_features.feature: Campus-safety functions include vehicle tracking, RFID, biometrics, visitor management, and infirmary.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Schools can connect software workflows with transport and on-campus safety operations.

distinctive_features.feature: Tally integration synchronizes fee receivables, collections, and cancellations; payment gateways include Razorpay.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Indian schools can connect fee operations to familiar accounting and payment tools.

weaknesses.issue: Google Play reviewers report lag, missing or empty notifications, stale calendars, and sibling-account problems.
Teacher-app reviewers report hanging and missing class or profile data.
iOS reviewers report timetable loading failures, unavailable transport tracking, attachment difficulties, crashes, and unread-notification bugs.
Pricing is quote-based, with no public official rate card; third-party price listings conflict with historical reported pricing.
Public documentation is shallow for API schemas, hosting architecture, implementation, payroll statutes, data residency, and government identifiers.
Public evidence does not verify OneRoster, LTI, Ed-Fi, or SIF certification.
Publicly verified coverage does not include UDISE+, APAAR, GST, NIRF, or AISHE support.
Public web-review ratings rely on very small samples, limiting confidence in broad satisfaction claims.

ai_features: VED AI: grammar correction, lesson-plan and content suggestions, YouTube summarization, text simplification, tone changes, translation, and document extraction.
Examcell AI generates curriculum-aligned questions and supports difficulty balancing.
VED AI advertises data-driven and predictive insights; model providers and evaluation controls are undisclosed.
pricing_model_summary: No official public rate card; sales-quoted pricing. Cost may depend on modules, student count, campuses, implementation, and integrations. Third-party figures conflict.
biggest_strategic_gap: Mobile-app reliability complaints and limited public evidence for standards-based interoperability, technical documentation, and several Indian statutory reporting requirements.
